prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 会议室预订周视图（5/12–5/16） (language zh-CN).
Grid: 6 columns × 7 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "2025 春季校园招聘宣讲会（09:00–17:" spans 3 col × 1 row; "产品需求评审（09:00–12:00）｜A301" spans 1 col × 2 row; "新员工入职培训（13:30–16:30）｜C20" spans 1 col × 2 row; "客户方案演示与答疑（13:30–16:30）｜A" spans 1 col × 2 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "时间段" · longest unbreakable word 53px · one-line width 94px
  col 2: header "周一（5/12）" · longest unbreakable word 65px · one-line width 261px
  col 3: header "周二（5/13）" · longest unbreakable word 65px · one-line width 214px
  col 4: header "周三（5/14）" · longest unbreakable word 63px · one-line width 274px
  col 5: header "周四（5/15）" · longest unbreakable word 63px · one-line width 304px
  col 6: header "周五（5/16）" · longest unbreakable word 62px · one-line width 190px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 720px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 719px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"按时间段查看一周内的会议室预订，识别活动、时间和地点。","reading":"读者先沿左侧时间段定位，再横向比较各日安排；也会纵向查看某一天的预订。跨列活动表示连续多日，跨行活动表示覆盖多个时间段。","groups":["第1列是时间轴，应与各行保持清晰对应。","第2至第6列均为工作日，承担相同的日程展示作用，宽度应具有可比性。","横跨周三至周五的全天活动共享这三列的宽度；跨行活动可利用所覆盖的行高容纳换行。"],"keep_intact":["日期表头、时间段和会议时间中的数字与标点尽量保持完整。","会议室编号及线上等地点标识应保持完整，并易于与对应活动关联。","跨行或跨列活动的文字应仍能明确对应其覆盖的时间和日期。"],"may_wrap":["活动名称可按中文自然换行。","活动名称、括号内时间和分隔符后的地点可在彼此之间换行。","已有较高行或跨行单元格可吸收部分换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [109, 122, 122, 122, 122, 122] · table 720×534px · row heights [36, 60, 106, 106, 60, 106, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/6 · tallest cell 5 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [104, 125, 105, 135, 145, 105] · table 720×534px · row heights [60, 60, 106, 83, 60, 83, 83] · column headers wrapped 2/6 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [85, 127, 127, 127, 127, 126] · table 720×464px · row heights [36, 60, 83, 83, 60, 83, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/6 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"五个工作日等宽，日期表头保持单行，横向比较容易；跨列和跨行活动的覆盖范围清楚。","problems":"时间段和多项会议时间被拆成多行，周一、周二及跨行活动出现较多短行；多行被最高单元格撑高，留白分布不均。","cause":"时间列109px仍不足以容纳完整时间段；各日122px仅有101px内容宽度，活动名称、时间和地点容易互相挤占。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"周三、周四获得较多空间，部分活动的时间和地点更集中，跨行活动的文字也较紧凑。","problems":"周二和周五日期表头换行，表头高度增加；这两列的活动文字也显得拥挤，而相邻日期宽度差异削弱了平日之间的可比性。","cause":"周二、周五各105px，不足以容纳完整日期表头；周三135px、周四145px的增宽来自这两列和时间列。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"五个日期表头均为单行，工作日宽度接近，表格整体紧凑；相较r0A，多数活动减少了一行，行与行的节奏更均衡。","problems":"时间段仍在连接符处换行；周一和周二的会议时间分成多行，周三、周四的跨行活动也有较零碎的换行。","cause":"时间列85px只有64px内容宽度；工作日各约127px，虽比r0A稍宽，仍不足以让较长活动的名称、时间和地点同时完整排列。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"r1-balanced","widths":[85,130,122,128,132,122],"change":"以r0C为基础，维持较窄的时间列，将部分宽度从周二和周五移给周一、周三和周四，尝试改善较长及跨行活动的换行，同时保留接近的工作日宽度。"},{"name":"r1-timeline","widths":[94,125,122,126,128,124],"change":"适度加宽时间列，测试时间段的可读性是否改善；五个工作日仍保持相近宽度，观察这一取舍是否值得。"},{"name":"r1-equal","widths":[79,128,128,128,128,128],"change":"进一步压缩时间列并让五个工作日完全等宽，测试额外的内容宽度能否减少活动换行，同时检查时间段是否仍易于扫描。"}]}
